description: This Java class implements the ProductService interface, managing product-related operations such as adding descriptions, retrieving products by category or URL, managing product attributes, availability, images, and relationships, as well as creating, updating, deleting, and indexing products within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductService interface that manages product lifecycle operations including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and indexing in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description to a product and updates the search index.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products filtered by category IDs, optionally by language.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Gets the product description matching the specified language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product matching the specific SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product configured for a specific locale and language, setting availability and language data.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products belonging to a specific store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product based on its unique product code.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product, its images, relationships, and removes it from the search index.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and indexes a new product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a product along with its associated entities like availability, attributes, images, and relationships, maintaining consistency and updating the search index.
